title: Peruvian Sweet Potato Picarones
description: Buttery and light, these festive Peruvian picarones are a delicious dessert featuring sweet potatoes and a lacquer glaze, made with a white bread mix for a low-carb friendly treat. They are perfect for special occasions and holidays.

ingredients.name: lacquer glaze
ingredients.notes: made with powdered sugar and milk

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mashed sweet potatoes, white bread mix, eggs, milk, melted butter, anise seeds, and salt, and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes elastic and shiny.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Fry the dough balls for 2-3 minutes on each side until they are golden brown.
Remove the picarones from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Drizzle the lacquer glaze over the picarones and serve warm.
